description: What going live on Autoview costs, per venue. No token, no account: read-only, from Autoview's published price list. Each live exchange is its own subscription (most are $39.99 a month or $399.99 a year); practice/demo venues are free, and a few venues are free live. Returns { currency: "USD", venues: [{ exchange, name, live_monthly, live_yearly, demo, note, free_practice_venue?, live_venue? }], unknown?: [{ input, code: "unknown_exchange", fix }], how_to_go_live, source }. live_monthly and live_yearly are dollars (live_yearly is null when there is no yearly plan); demo is true for a practice venue (no real money, $0). Omit exchanges to list every venue. A refusal returns { error, code, fix }: bad_exchanges, too_many_exchanges, unknown_exchange. Do what fix says.

exchanges.description: optional venue ids, any spelling, up to 60, e.g. ["kraken", "oanda", "alpaca_paper"]; omit for every venue

name: pricing
